description: Send (queue) an email message from a domain to a recipient, recording the message and an 'accepted' delivery event.

sender.description: The From address for the message.

to.description: The recipient address for the message.

subject.description: Optional subject line for the message.

text.description: Optional plain-text body for the message.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the queued message id and a confirmation message; on failure (missing from/to), output contains an error message.

description: Query delivery events for a domain, optionally filtered by event type and recipient, returned newest first.

domain.description: The domain to query events for.

event.description: Optional event type filter; supports multiple values joined by ' OR ' (e.g. 'delivered OR opened').

recipient.description: Optional recipient address to filter events by.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-300, default 300).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with an 'items' list of event objects and a 'paging' object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get total event counts for a domain, optionally limited to a comma-separated list of event types.

domain.description: The domain to compute stats for.

event.description: Optional comma-separated list of event types to count (default: accepted, delivered, failed, opened, clicked).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with start/end timestamps, resolution, and a 'stats' list of per-event totals; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List the members of a mailing list, optionally filtered by subscription state.

subscribed.description: Optional subscription flag; when set, only members matching this subscribed state are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with an 'items' list of member objects and a 'total_count'; on failure (mailing list not found), output contains an error message.
